name: self-desktop
description: Lets a session read its own machine's desktop on Windows, read only: it lists the windows a person could see (program, rectangle, monitor, state, which is in front; a title only for Windows Terminal windows and the session's own), reads the session's own terminal window (its controls and its own pane's text, never from a console another program shares), and captures a classic console window of the session's own to a local PNG (a picture of a Windows Terminal window isn't built). It never clicks, types, focuses, moves or closes anything. Off until you turn it on.

updateCheck.title: Update check
updateCheck.description: on: when a tool of this plugin is called and the last check is 30 minutes old, fetch this plugin's published plugin.json from GitHub (a plain GET of a public file) and say when a newer version is out. off: never check.

enabled.title: Read the desktop
enabled.description: off (the default): every tool answers that self-desktop is off, and nothing is read. on: desktop_windows lists the windows a person could see (a title only for Windows Terminal windows and this session's own), desktop_read reads this session's own terminal window and its own pane's text, and desktop_capture saves a picture of this session's own classic console window to a local file (a picture of a Windows Terminal window isn't built). Each call also goes through your own permission rules. Old pictures are deleted at each call and session start, whatever this says. Windows only. Read only: nothing is clicked, typed, focused, moved or closed.
